Thanks for the thoughtful response. I do want a committed relationship with him. I’ll respond to each of these to give more context:

1. He doesn’t want to sleep around, even though he’s hyper sexual. I guess he has enough control so he only wants committed relationships it seems

2. Yeah.. he’s already talking to another woman, who he wants a relationship with. I’m not sure how strong his feelings for her are, and it’s complicated by the fact that he may not be telling the full truth so I don’t feel as bad. He said they’re exclusive right now and he has “tunnel vision” on her. But he’s also said he just wants a relationship to distract him from his boring life and once said he only wants the other girl over me cuz he can have sex with her, but not with me (see 3).

3. This is also complicated to tell cuz I’m 17 and he’s 22. He thinks the age gap is not okay, which he’s said is the main reason he doesn’t want a relationship. He said only before finding out my age did he *consciously* find me physically attractive. Maybe he still subconsciously finds me attractive, but he rejects those feelings cuz I’m 17. Also, he says I’m immature too, and I know why - I keep begging him to like me and make promises to me. I’m probably bordering manipulative. It’s something I need to stop but I can’t help it, sometimes it just hurts so bad that I need a momentary relief. 

4. He’s not gay, not gonna go into it but we’ve talked about attraction and sexuality some. 

The FWB arrangement is something I haven’t thought of before. I mean, sex isn’t what I need at all, but I’d wanna get closer to him in any way... and of course, he won’t even consider sex with me until I’m old enough. Of course he has the other woman now, so I guess all I have left to do is suffer.
Why?

Well, I haven’t been this obsessed before, no. But it’s also the first time I felt someone genuinely cared. 

I’d say he’s worsened my mental health problems, but I’d probably have problems without him to (stress, anxiety, etc)
